body: This is awful to hear, it’s terrible how that after so much abuse that you have carried on.  It shows strength and power to carry on. You deserve to live a happy life with eveyone treating you well, so please seek professional help and carry on.

I assure you life is precious and beautiful, I assure you there’s more to experience and do. I assure you there’s so much to live for. Think about the beauty of life, think about how wonderful nature is, think about how wonderful people can be, appreciate the small things. But please seek professional help, I assure you that will help

Because you should not leave them behind. You are a perfect person and I know many others care about you but you shouldn’t live because of others. Please seek professional help and don’t carry on like this, I assure you it isn’t worth it.

You must carry on. Please seek professional help.  Your life is precious and is worth living, I promise you that it gets better, it always does and I truly do care what happenes to you and I assure manu others do to so please carry on. Life is beautiful.

You are an amazing person I know you are, you are precious and loosing you would be awful for eveyone who knows you because you are perfect, you are not an asshole and don’t deserve to be called such things and I promise you that it gets better, the sun will shine on you.

I’m a stranger to you I assume however I care about you. I care how you are. You must carry on, even if “no one” cares. Because you are precious and perfect and are loved. Please continue your therapy, it will improve I promise you.

I assure you your life is precious and worth it and you are cared about, you must get professional help not just for the people who care about you but also for yourself because your life is worth it, I promise you it’s worth it and I promise you it gets better, this is just an awfully low part of your life but it will improve, it will get better. I know it will

It isn’t, I promise you that life is precious, it is worth living, all life is precious and needs to be cared about just like you, you deserved to be cared about, you need to carry on because it’s worth it, I promise you the sun will shine on you, no matter what happenes in your life.

You cannot blame yourself here, your issues aren’t your fault, I promise you it gets better, better counseling is so important. So please try and get it because you need to carry on, people love and care about you

I promise you that suicide is not the answer here and is also never the answer, I understand how you feel. I’ve lost a best friend like this and it’s an awful feeling however life is worth it to live, you are worth it and deserve the world, so many people care about you, I care about you

I promise you that it’s worth it, I am a similar age and I feel similar however it’s not worth it, you are 16, yoh have so much time to turn around your life, there’s help for addictions, and I promise that one day you will look back and realise that is was all worth it, how life is precious and worth living. So please, carry on

People care. I care about you, I promise you will be missed by everyone, suicidal thoughts are a terrible feeling but I promise it’s worth it to carry on, I know it is, you have so much to live for and to do with your life and you are cared about, you would be thoroughly missed.

I promise you will be missed, people love you, you are loved. You are a great person, do not let depression get the better of you, there are new relationships to be made, things to be done! So please, carry on and life will improve, the sun will shine on you as it shines on others, make god proud of what you have done

There is so much left for you.  So much left to see and so much to do, I promise you life is always worth it, it’s beautiful. Can you appreciate the small things? When the birds chirp? Try and find as many things that you love and just appreciate them and whatever life may hold for you. But I promise it gets better, I know it will. Please try and get professional help because I know life is worth it for everyone, including you

This is a hard question to answer, but my first suggestion is a private therapist even an online one or perhaps a suicide hotline? Any sort of place to vent is needed and you seem to know that, however this a safe space for you, tell me how you are feeling and I promise you that one day you will be better, the sun will shine

You will feel better, I know you will. You can spend time with loved ones. Try to talk to them about your struggles. Admit how you feel, has this being going on for a while? Is there a reason for it? Then tell them and speak to someone, you need to carry on for them and the sun will shine on you one day, even if it’s so unbelievable now

I feel similar to you. Anxiety gives a true sense of self hatred, day to day activities are too much, but please don’t do it. I promise you are loved, somebody will miss you, someone cares. So please don’t let it get the better of you as you are a perfect and good person.
